01 · Foundation

Brand essence

Inspired by Indian goddesses. Made by Indian goddesses. For goddesses who know how to party. Not traditionally "ethnic," not a Western festival-fashion copy, but a global-looking, Indian-born party brand.

Fabulous

Every look should feel like an entrance. Glamour is not extra. It's the baseline.

Bold

Color, cut and confidence, turned up. Nothing in this closet is a whisper.

Fearless

Dress for the night you want, not the one you're expected to have.

Let's spread PLURP
Peace · Love · Unity · Respect · Party: the culture the brand is built to protect, not just the clothes it sells.
02 · Identity

Logo & symbol

The primary mark is YNS in iridescent, chameleon-shift color, with YASS and SASS locked underneath. It only ever appears on black or bone, never on a busy photo without a solid plate behind it.

YNS
Yass  ·  Sass
01

Primary lockup: iridescent, always shimmering, YNS on black, full wordmark in white directly beneath, always centered, never justified wide.

02

Reversed lockup: solid ink YNS on bone, for light applications like print or packaging tags, where the shimmer can't render.

03

Glow is allowed: a soft neon bloom behind the mark on dark digital surfaces (loading states, hero moments) is on-brand. Keep it soft; the mark should glow like a light source, not wear a sticker outline.

×

Never recolor the gradient to a flat brand color, stretch the mark, or set it on a mid-tone background where it loses contrast.

A real peacock feather is the brand's second mark: shot, not drawn. The eye and its iridescent rings are exactly what a feather actually looks like, because no illustration earns that shimmer honestly. The same shift-with-the-light color logic runs through the wordmark, the palette and every glow moment on site.

Use it standalone as an avatar, stamp or hangtag seal, always on black. Never redraw or vectorize it: the mark is always sourced from a real feather photograph, never an illustration.

Avatars Hangtags Packaging seals Loading states
03 · Palette

Color & iridescence

Black is the stage - but the peacock's chest is the whole point. Iridescence isn't a rare accent here, it's the brand's core material: it moves, it catches light, it shows up everywhere color does. Chrome is what makes that possible - the metallic base every shimmer is built on.

Ink#0B0C10
Bone#F3EFE6
Chrome#9AA0AC
Peacock Teal#16A39A
Peacock Blue#3F7FD6
Peacock Magenta#C4419A
Peacock Gold#D9A13C
Iridescence · the signature effect, always in motion

Every named hue is a shimmer, not a chip - teal drifts toward cyan and blue, magenta drifts toward violet and pink, gold drifts toward magenta. Chrome is the odd one that isn't a hue at all: a dark-to-bright-to-dark metallic sweep blended under every shimmer, the same way a real feather's color only shows because the structure underneath is catching light like polished metal. Nothing in this palette is meant to sit still.

Same palette, disco cut

The swatches, mirrored

The flat chips above, rebuilt as spinning mirror balls: hundreds of individually-lit facets wrapped over a true sphere, catching one fixed light source as they turn - the same shimmer logic, just spherical.

Trip. Glow. Repeat.
Ravers chase the glow - so key moments (the wordmark, the feather, a hover state, a drop countdown) get a soft neon bloom behind them. Glow marks a moment; it doesn't fill a room.

05 · Shop-by-genre

06 · Voice

How Yass & Sass talks

She's the friend who gets you dressed and gets you out the door on time. Direct, playful, a little bit dared - never apologetic, never precious.

We sound like

  • A dare, not a suggestion. "Wear the thing you almost didn't buy."
  • Genre-fluent. We know the difference between a Boho Psy crowd and a Berlin warehouse.
  • Confident and short. One good line beats three hedged ones.
  • In on the culture. PLURP, omY'S Club and drop language used like they're already common knowledge.

We don't sound like

  • A fast-fashion blast. No "HUGE SALE!!!" energy or discount-first messaging.
  • Traditional "ethnic wear" marketing. We're Indian-born, not a heritage costume brand.
  • A Western festival brand in translation. No borrowed Coachella clichés.
  • Corporate or apologetic. Never hedge a bold look with "if you dare" disclaimers.
Drop announcementThe Berlin Underground drop is live. Dress like the bassline.

07 · Beyond fashion

The larger idea

Rural craft.
Urban night.

Supporting rural women of India to help urban women of India party better. Where possible, the ecosystem creates opportunities through craftsmanship, embellishment, textiles and production - connecting Indian craft with India's nightlife culture. Not framed as charity: as part of the value chain, from making to designing to wearing.

Fashion is the entry point. The long-term platform extends into:

· Jewellery, bags, footwear & body adornment
· Beauty and nightlife essentials
· Limited artist & DJ collaborations
· Festival pop-ups and brand experiences
· omY'S Club membership and party updates
